narrative.overview:
Light (`ink`, default) and Dark (`black`) share one watercolor composition, EB Garamond lettering, restrained Hanken prose, aligned navigation and reading pages. White uses cool pale paper and navy ink; Black uses near-black blue paper, light ink and a graphite/silver dragon. The dragon and exact right-side poem belong only to the homepage hero. The lower homepage and inner pages use quiet related paper, with live HTML text and controls.

Red (`dark`) retains the Persona 5-inspired red, black, cutout lettering and grayscale portrait. P3 (`light`) was removed at the author’s request on 2026-11-04; its stylesheet is archived locally and never loaded. Classic remains retired. Both removed preferences resolve to Light. Names shown to visitors are simple and familiar: Light, Dark and Game.
keyCharacteristics: White and Black are palette/artwork siblings with the same layout and typography.
Shared dragon-theme shells and page heads align Research, Publications, Library and CV.

Three distinct scientific scenes show a virtual agent workbench, dissipative quantum computation and local-system learning. Short HTML captions and active callouts clarify the animation; original figures remain linked.
Game preserves the graphic appearance; removed P3 preferences fall back to Light.

rules.name: The Selected Appearance Rule
rules.body: Light, Dark and Game are the three valid choices. Preserve explicit choices across routes and tabs; absent, invalid, removed `normal` and removed `light` preferences fall back to Light. `assets/appearances.json` is the shared manifest for names, IDs, browser color and stylesheet selection.

rules.name: The Separate Artwork Rule
rules.body: Keep the dragon and exact poem in the homepage hero, and keep names, prose and controls as live HTML. Extend quiet related paper through the lower home and inner pages. Treat Research drawings as schematic explanations, not measured results or numerical simulations, and preserve original scientific figures as linked evidence.

dos: Do keep White and Black as palette/artwork siblings with aligned reading shells and page heads.
Do preserve the original portrait, scientific figures, semantic headings, useful alternatives, focus and reduced motion.
Do keep the interface English apart from the established Chinese name and exact poem.
Do keep research themes concise, explain each with a short labeled sequence, and reserve the full paper catalog for Publications.
Do retain full academic/news source data and editable collaboration drafts without presenting interests as achieved results.
Do preserve Game and migrate retired P3 preferences to Light.
donts: Don't restore Classic, the narrow in-scene reader, an inner-page dragon or a left-side phone poem.
Don't reintroduce repeated homepage research paragraphs, profile groups, full-result Research catalogs or legacy footer clusters.
Don't invent research claims, affiliations or publication facts, or present conceptual imagery as scientific evidence.
Don't equate technical checks or historical ship verdicts with the user's current aesthetic acceptance.
